items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: Those might be projects that I’ve worked on over the years.

ctx.x: In the form of a trivia question, and you’ll probably see where this is going in a hurry. What do these media events or people have in common: “The Incredibles,” Rosemary Clooney, “Family Guy,” Gordon Goodwin’s Big Phat Band, and Green Day?
Huge egos. Those might be projects that I’ve worked on over the years.
That’s right and you know I could do that for the next hour, just read them. So speaking of huge egos, do you find it necessary to have an ego in your business or is it better not to have one?
